items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Eddie Woods is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Um, a fellow by the name of Louis Capit. Yes, guitar. Uh-huh. And another fellow by the name of Faisal.
Yeah. I know him. Eddie, Eddie Woods was his real name. Yeah.
Uh-huh. And another fellow by the name of Oral Humphrey. Humphrey.
